turns.question: Summarize this patient's last visit.
turns.answer_section:
The patient's most recent clinical visit occurred on 2026-01-26 at an OPD Visit at Unknown Location [35], [6]. The patient is a 25-year-old male [106] who is part of a discordant couple [9] and is currently in WHO stage 3 adult [22].

Clinical findings on 2026-01-26 included:
1. Vital signs: Blood pressure 120/80 mmHg [19], [17], pulse 80 beats/min [18], temperature 36.4 DEG C [20], and oxygen saturation 96% [16].
2. Weight: 67 kg [21].
3. Adherence: The patient reported all antiretroviral adherence in the past week [13] and all PCP prophylaxis adherence in the past week [15], but reported no overall drug adherence in the last month [14].

Medications and plans:
1. New drug orders were placed for Trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole [2], Stavudine [3], Lamivudine [4], and Nevirapine [5].
2. The antiretroviral plan is to continue the regimen [29].
3. The PCP prophylaxis plan is to continue the regimen [31].
4. No current cryptococcus treatment [26], [30], tuberculosis prophylaxis [27], [32], or tuberculosis treatment [28], [33] was reported or planned.

Additionally, the patient was enrolled in the Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) disease program on 2026-02-16 [1].
